rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Maintainer blocks point, don't restate. Link architecture doc where they touch delivery
rules_evaluated.evidence: This file's own 'Themes planted' note claims 'Compounding theme lands in Ex3.' Cross-checked against the other three M1 exercise files: close-the-ticket.md (Ex3) carries no Themes-planted section at all, while compound-and-close.md (Ex4) explicitly claims 'Theme 2 (compounding builds the system)' as its own planted theme. The 'Compounding theme' this note points at actually lands in Ex4, not Ex3 -- a stale cross-file fact (getting-going.md's own history note, 'do not re-order compound ahead of the close,' suggests this is a leftover from a prior ordering). Harm: an editor or auditor trusting this note would expect Theme-2 evidence in close-the-ticket.md and could misdirect edits there instead of compound-and-close.md.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Correct 'Compounding theme lands in Ex3' to name Ex4/compound-and-close.md, matching that file's own Themes-planted claim.
